title: What Plants Need to Stay Healthy
seo_title: Year 2 Science: What Plants Need Worksheets (Water, Light and Warmth)
standard_text: Find out and describe how plants need water, light and a suitable temperature to grow and stay healthy.
meta_desc: Free Year 2 science worksheets on what plants need to stay healthy: water, light and a suitable temperature, spotting problems and simple plant tests. 100 questions with answers.
key_sub: Too little or too much water, light or warmth can harm a plant.
body_html:
How to think about it

Plants need water, light and warmth.

  • No water: the plant wilts.
  • No light: the plant goes pale and weak.
  • Too hot or too cold: the plant is harmed.
Example

Cress in a dark cupboard?

No light

Answer: pale and weak

Example

Tomato plant on a frosty night?

Too cold

Answer: its leaves may be damaged

Common mistakes

  • Thinking plants grow best in the dark.
  • Thinking more water is always better.
  • Thinking plants do not mind frost.

faq.q: What do plants need to stay healthy?
faq.a: Plants need water, light and a suitable temperature (not too hot and not too cold).

faq.q: What happens if a plant gets no light?
faq.a: It cannot make its food, so it grows pale, thin and weak.

faq.q: How can I test what a plant needs?
faq.a: Grow two plants the same way, but change one thing, such as light. Then compare how they grow.

items.q: A basil plant is kept in the fridge. What will happen?
